The official EOM section is within Department of Technology and Innovation and directly identifies ongoing PhD projects at Engineering Operations Management. Together these establish a doctoral research pathway in the explicitly named Operations field, beyond a generic faculty research interest. The official PhD-school organisation page explicitly identifies the conferred PhD in Engineering Science / Ingeniørvidenskab and formal affiliation of admitted doctoral students with a department and research group in a centre/section. Section and departmental responsibilities in doctoral enrolment, plans, assessment and dissertation are specified.
limitations: Exact general award is PhD in Engineering Science / Ingeniørvidenskab, as conferred by the Faculty of Engineering; Operations Management is an individualized doctoral research area, not a separate diploma or formal concentration. EOM remains a section within the actual Department of Technology and Innovation.
